title: Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours: Enduro trip through red dunes and desert canyons | Enduro-Vietnam
description: Enduro motorcycle tours in Mui Ne. Powerful bikes, professional off-road tires, and unique routes through endless sand dunes and wild canyons that are hidden from regular tourists. We work all year round and provide training for beginners.

children.text: Our bases are located in key locations across Vietnam, providing rental and support services wherever you need them.
We have conducted hundreds of tours and know the safest and most exciting routes in the country
💲 THE PRICE OF THE TOUR (3 hours)

We chose the Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours for an enduro trip through the stunning red dunes and desert canyons. I was a bit nervous about my lack of riding experience. However, our guide quickly eased my concerns. Within a short time, he taught me the essential techniques and boosted my confidence, allowing us to fully enjoy the breathtaking landscapes.

During our tour, we truly embraced the thrill of riding — we navigated the stunning red dunes, explored desert canyons, and tackled sandy paths. It was an exhilarating experience that made our trip to Mui Ne unforgettable! 😊 I must highlight the guide's exceptional skills — he expertly guided us through the challenges of enduro riding, making it accessible for both beginners and seasoned riders alike. I highly recommend this adventure for anyone looking for excitement amidst the beautiful landscapes of Mui Ne!

I booked the Mui Ne Motorcycle Tour for my birthday, excited to explore the stunning red dunes. My partner, who's new to off-roading, felt anxious at first, especially on the challenging terrain. We both had limited experience but our guide, Boris, was incredibly supportive. Instead of just a ride, he focused on teaching us the skills we needed while making it an unforgettable adventure through the breathtaking desert canyons.

We spent an unforgettable day exploring the stunning red dunes and desert canyons of Mui Ne on our enduro bikes. Initially, we received thorough training, making sure everyone was comfortable on their ride. It was exhilarating to navigate through the challenging terrain, including sandy slopes and rocky paths. With the stunning scenery around us, each twist and turn felt like an adventure waiting to unfold. The thrill of conquering rough tracks together bonded us even further. The experience was not just about the ride but the memories we created along the way. I highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for excitement and a unique way to connect with nature! 🌟

Do you offer any gear, flat tire kits, or basic tool sets?
Here is the information on each item:
-Coffers: Unfortunately, there are no cofers. For long-distance trips, we have experience in securely securing luggage on the trunk using slings.
-Wheel repair kit and a minimum set of tools:

Since we mainly drive around the vicinity of Mui Ne, we rely on the availability of local tire shops, where repairs can be completed within 10-30 minutes. However, if it is crucial for your peace of mind, we can provide a minimum set of tools and a wheel repair kit.

Experience: We always recommend to take a rope with you on a trip. In our practice, there were cases (for example, a chain break) when this helped to easily tow the motorcycle to the nearest repair service without difficulties.
Where are we going? Only in Mui Ne?
We ride through the scenic landscapes of Mui Ne, exploring the stunning red dunes and desert canyons. Our tours cater to all skill levels.
Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours: Enduro adventure through vibrant red dunes and stunning desert landscapes | Enduro-Vietnam
Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours: Full-day adventure begins at 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with flexible rental options available.
Can I ride a motorcycle in Mui Ne without prior experience?
Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours: Experience the thrill of an Enduro trip through stunning red dunes and breathtaking desert canyons | Enduro-Vietnam
What equipment is included in the Mui Ne motorcycle tours?

The rental price covers an enduro motorcycle and a helmet for protection. It's advised to wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes that can handle dirt. Sneakers with laces are also recommended. Slippers are not suitable.
Do I need an international driving license to ride an enduro bike in Mui Ne?
Although a license is required, Mui Ne is a popular destination for enduro tours. Tourists can ride freely through the stunning landscapes without concerns from local authorities💫
What should be left as a deposit?
You can secure your booking with a 200💲 deposit or use your passport as a guarantee for small repairs.
Who covers costs for motorcycle breakdowns or damages?
Anything that occurs due to the client's actions (injuries, damages) will be covered by the client during repairs.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We will be your local guide in Mui Ne, sharing insights on must-see spots🏖️, the best local cuisine🍜, vibrant bars🍹, and exciting events to enjoy🎉.
Does the Tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?

Of course! Our routes include the coolest natural spots in Dalat. We often drive right next to the iconic Datanla and Elephant Waterfalls, as well as take a look at Kau Dat Tea Hill. We can even stop by Chuk Lam Monastery for a quick overview. It will be an unforgettable Tour of the surroundings of Dalat! 🏞️🏍️
Do you only offer enduro tours, or are there other experiences available?

First of all, we are experts in enduro motorcycles and off-roading. But if you want even more extreme, for example, to try the Dalat Canyoning Tour (this is a descent through waterfalls!), we will definitely recommend our trusted and reliable partners. 🧗👍
Is it possible to combine an enduro tour with a coffee tour?
Mui Ne Motorcycle Tours: Explore stunning red dunes and desert canyons on an unforgettable enduro adventure.
How is your Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) different from Enduro Tour+?

The difference is huge! An Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) is when you're being driven by a guide. Our tour is your personal adrenaline rush! You're in control of the dirt bike (Enduro), and we'll tackle the most challenging off-road trails together. It's an active, self-paced adventure! 🤘🚦
What is the weather in Mui Ne by month? When is the best time to visit for motorcycle tours, considering the rainy season?

The weather in Mui Ne can be quite changeable, especially during the rainy season. However, we have a tip! Statistics show that on 5 out of 7 days, mornings are usually dry. It's the perfect time to hit the trails and enjoy an exhilarating ride. Starting early is highly recommended! 🌞🏍️
Do you exclusively rent enduro motorcycles or do you offer motocross motorcycles as well?

Our main focus is, of course, on enduro motorcycles for off-roading. We don't rent out cross-country motorcycles ourselves, but we can connect you with our Vietnamese colleagues who offer them. Just keep in mind that the price is higher there. Anything you want for your money! Do you want an outdoor kitchen or a barbecue? Just ask! 😉💸
